exposure: abnormal umbilical cord (velamentous insertion, marginal insertion, single umbilical artery (SUA), knots, entanglement)
placental abnormalities (retained placenta, placental abruption, placenta previa)
cohort: All liveborn singletons (n=1,087,486) born in Norway between 1999 and 2017 were included.
finding: Abnormalities of the umbilical cord (velamentous insertion, cord knots) and placenta (placenta previa, placental abruption, retained placenta) are associated with an increased risk of cerebral palsy.
